title: Labour Standards Code
verified_how: the statutes register itself could NOT be reached (nslegislature.ca refused the connection - see access_notes), so in-force status is unverified and is recorded as unclear. The title and citation were verified instead on the Government of Nova Scotia's Office of the Registrar of Regulations site on 2026-09-23: fetched https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regs/lscgenls.htm, which states it is made under subsection 4(2) and Section 7 of the Labour Standards Code and gives the enabling Act's citation as 'R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 246'; the Act also appears as a live heading in the official 'Regulations by Act' index at https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regsbyact.htm, which lists Acts with regulations currently in force
notes: Nova Scotia's employment standards statute is styled a Code, not an Act. Minimum wage, pay periods and wage recovery. The register copy, which could not be fetched, is at https://nslegislature.ca/sites/default/files/legc/statutes/labour%20standards%20code.pdf.
